source.stem:
Which of the following options regarding Darwin’s theory of natural selection is incorrect ( )
A. All living things generally have strong reproductive capabilities
B. If living things want to survive, they must fight for survival in order to obtain food and space.
C. Variations produced by organisms must be conducive to adapting to the environment
D. Organisms that do not adapt to the environment will be eliminated

options.text: All living things generally have strong reproductive capabilities
If living things want to survive, they have to fight for food and space.
Variations produced by organisms must be conducive to adapting to the environment
Creatures that do not adapt to the environment will be eliminated

hinge.title: Decide why holding the breath becomes difficult and why oxygen in air is essential for survival.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: We cannot hold our breath for long because the body needs nitrogen from the air.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The body stops functioning the instant a person holds their breath.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: With oxygen, a person can survive indefinitely without food or water.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Humans die within a few minutes without food or water.

intelligence.enrichment: The air we breathe in has oxygen. The body needs oxygen to perform its functions, so it is difficult to hold the breath for a long time and humans cannot survive without oxygen for even a few minutes. When breathing stops, fresh oxygen is no longer taken into the lungs, so the body's need for oxygen quickly makes breath-holding difficult and unsafe. The learner correctly applies this rule: The air we breathe in has oxygen. The body needs oxygen to perform its functions, so it is difficult to hold the breath for a long time and humans cannot survive without oxygen for even a few minutes. Breath-holding becomes difficult only because lungs get tired, not because oxygen is needed by the body.
